correctness.rationale: The level-three block decomposition has minimum block length 100 and all 00/01/10/11 source pairs occur. Therefore the four complete block-pair strings exhaust all length-at-most-25 factors. Exhaustive exact reversal checks enumerate 37 palindromes and exclude lengths 24 and 25; central-subfactor logic excludes all longer lengths. Testing the two symmetric extensions of every candidate yields six maximal factors. Standalone verifier independently checks explicit constants and an 18,750-letter prefix.

value.rationale: The morphism defines a natural aperiodic 5-automatic word prominent in research on abelian complexity. Complete palindromic-language determination, a sharp global length-23 cutoff, all six center-maximal factors and the exact complexity function are nontrivial structural invariants rather than sampled-prefix counts. In particular, this verifies the finite-palindrome hypothesis for applying Frid–Laborde–Peltomäki to this specific word.
